reason: PURE. What I noticed first was the QR code and 'Every batch lab-tested' on the front, plus that it's plain bisglycinate with no citrate, which is what gives me cramps. I'd try one box to see if it's gentle on my stomach, but only one, since there are no reviews yet.
objection: I hate big pills and nothing here says how big the capsules are. Two capsules a day at 100 mg each worries me, and the brand has zero reviews so I can't check anyone else's experience with them.
would_change_my_mind: A listed capsule size or a few honest reviews from real buyers saying the capsules are easy to swallow and don't upset the stomach.
